load_dino_model: load a pretrained DINO vision transformer model by name like dino_vits16 or dino_vitb16 using __model_loader__
extract_vit_features: extract CLS token and patch embeddings from an image tensor using the DINOv1Adapter forward pass
get_vit_self_attention: get the last layer self-attention weights from a VisionTransformer model using get_last_selfattention
get_vit_intermediate_layers: get normalized output tokens from the last N blocks of a VisionTransformer using get_intermediate_layers
load_dino_resnet50: load a pretrained DINO ResNet-50 model using dino_resnet50 for feature extraction
